mechanism_narrative: Positive month-over-month growth in industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO growth rate is positive.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.0% indicates restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand that drives corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS growth rates are positive.

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 3.5%), tight labor markets support consumer spending and corporate profit margins, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE is below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI inflation rate above 3.0% signals persistent inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) indicate a restrictive monetary policy environment with persistent inflation, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Positive month-over-month growth in housing starts (HOUST) correlates with broader economic expansion and corporate investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where HOUST growth rate is positive.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in nonfarm payrolls above 100,000 jobs (PAYEMS growth > 100) signals a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS growth exceeds 100.
